data.command: Give me a simple 3-step plan to start running
data.draft:
To start running, follow these simple steps: 
1. Consult a doctor, especially if you have any health concerns, to ensure it's safe for you to begin a running program. 
2. Invest in a good pair of running shoes that provide adequate support and cushioning for your feet, as this will help prevent injuries and make your runs more comfortable. 
3. Start with short, manageable distances, such as walking for a few minutes and then jogging for a minute, and gradually increase your running time as your body adapts to the new demands.
Remember to listen to your body and only do as much as feels comfortable, as overexerting yourself can lead to injury or burnout. It's also a good idea to find a safe and enjoyable route for your runs, such as a local park or trail, and consider running with a buddy or joining a running group for motivation and support.
Additionally, tracking your progress and setting achievable goals can be a great motivator, so consider using a running app or log to monitor your distance, pace, and overall improvement over time. This will help you see how far you've come and stay motivated to continue challenging yourself, and you can also use this data to adjust your training plan as needed to avoid plateaus and prevent overtraining.
